name: mcp-hugo-server-go
description: Manage a Hugo static site — create, edit, and publish content, run builds, and audit site health — from Claude Desktop, over a local stdio connection.

site_root.title: Hugo build output directory
site_root.description: The Hugo build output directory (Hugo's publishDir, normally {hugo_root}/public). Must NOT be your Hugo project root — see the operator guide for why.

hugo_root.title: Hugo project root
hugo_root.description: The root of your Hugo project (contains content/, themes/, hugo.toml).

content_root.title: Hugo content directory
content_root.description: Where your Markdown content files live (normally {hugo_root}/content).

site_url.title: Site URL
site_url.description: The public URL of your Hugo site (e.g. https://www.example.com).

site_name.title: Site name
site_name.description: A display name for your site.
